Name: Xiddav's Parks - Witch Swamp
Author: xiddav
Description:
Witch Swamp edit. Plus new areas accessible from the Witch Portal Cave.

New Areas
1. Far North
Always Winter  [img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/thumb/a/a7/Winter.png/24px-Winter.png[/img]
Snows most days
can plant crops
Ice fishing spot. Catch Perch and Lingcod.

2. Graveyard
Always Fall   [img]https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/images/thumb/5/5d/Fall.png/24px-Fall.png[/img]
Storm most days 
skeletons and ghosts spawn
can plant fruit trees
Has a building (corrupted house of yoba)


Changes to the witch swamp:
More land

Void Salmon value increase (150 -> 450)

New fishing item - Void Jelly
Crafting (Fishing level 6)
Void Jelly + Seaweed = Sea Jelly
Void Jelly + Green Algae = River Jelly
Void Jelly + White Algae = Cave Jelly
